title: Coi Profile Configuration
description: Schema for Coi (Code on Incus) profile config.toml files

context.description: Path to context .md file (resolved relative to profile directory)

forward_env.description: Host environment variable names to forward into the container

environment.description: Environment variables to set inside the container. Empty string value clears an inherited key.

env_commands.description: Map of env var name to a host command run at session start; the command's trimmed stdout is injected as the value. Honored only from trusted-scope config (~/.coi/config.toml / $COI_CONFIG); the minted value is present in the container env for the session.

env_command_timeout.description: Timeout (duration string, e.g. "5s") bounding each env_commands invocation for this profile. Trusted-scope only, like env_commands. Mirrors [defaults] env_command_timeout.

prompts.description: Named predefined prompts for `coi run --prompt-name <name>` (#701). Each value is either an inline string or a { file = "..." } table. A file= entry is honored only from trusted-scope config (it reads a host file); an untrusted project config's file= entry is stripped at load.

mounts.description: Additional host directories to mount into the container. Accepts either the flat array form ([[mounts]]) or the nested { default = [...] } form ([[mounts.default]]) — the same two shapes top-level [mounts] accepts — so mount blocks are symmetric across config scopes. Uses if/then/else (not oneOf) so an invalid entry in the array form still reports a precise mounts[i] error path.

sockets.description: Host Unix sockets to forward into the container

credentials.description: Host credential files to copy into the container: named catalog bundles or ad-hoc host/container pairs

ports.description: Container TCP ports published on the host (localhost by default) via Incus proxy devices

pool.description: Number of identity-mapped ports to publish per session (host port == container port, allocated per workspace/slot)
